name: NXT Tickets & Events
author: Nxtapps

sections.description:
NXT Tickets & Events is a standalone event-ticketing experience that uses WooCommerce for cart, checkout, orders, and payment handling.

Features include:

  • Free, Standard, VIP, and custom ticket tiers.
  • Ticket capacity and stock synchronization.
  • Guest and registered-customer checkout.
  • Saved friends and family profiles.
  • Group QR passes attached to customer email.
  • Public ticket-verification pages.
  • Event directory and per-event pages.
  • Light, dark, and automatic frontend color modes.
  • Flat and Spotlight ticket-card layouts.

WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Third-Party Libraries

NXT Tickets & Events includes:

  • flatpickr 4.6.13, MIT License, https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr
  • endroid/qr-code and its Composer dependencies. Their license files are included in vendor/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nxt-tickets-events folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate NXT Tickets & Events.
  3. Confirm WooCommerce is active.
  4. Open NXT Tickets & Events in the WordPress dashboard and create an event.
  5. Configure the NXT Tickets & Events email under WooCommerce > Settings > Emails.
sections.faq:
Does NXT Tickets & Events process payments?

No. WooCommerce and its configured payment gateways process checkout and payment. NXT Tickets & Events issues passes from eligible WooCommerce orders.

Are QR codes generated locally?

Yes. NXT Tickets & Events bundles an open-source QR-code library and does not require an external QR service.

Can guests purchase tickets?

Yes. Guest buyers enter the required ticket-holder information during checkout.
